title: C4OS Grill Question 015 - Plugin Icon Reordering
notes_or_corrections: A plugin should be able to configure its own settings form for the user to fill out. The user needs to click the plugin to configure it. Actual user configs for all plugins should be stored in the user level.

questions.label: Where should users reorder plugin icons?

options: Both Settings and direct header drag/drop
